lines.zh: 我拖着门板一步步往前挪。
lines.en: I drag my door-slab shield forward, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 木门在石地上刮出长痕。
lines.en: The wooden door scrapes a long groove through the stone.

lines.zh: 每走三步，我就换只手举门。
lines.en: Every three steps I switch the door to my other arm.

lines.zh: 阳光照在我身上，我照走不误。
lines.en: Sunlight pours over me and I keep walking anyway.

lines.zh: 门轴吱呀响，像在替我数步子。
lines.en: The hinges creak as if counting my steps.

lines.zh: 我把门斜过来，挡住正面的风。
lines.en: I tilt the door to block the wind from the front.

lines.zh: 靴子里灌了土，我照旧迈步。
lines.en: My boots are full of dirt and I still march.

lines.zh: 我沿着村口的栅栏慢慢绕。
lines.en: I shuffle along the village fence, taking the long way.

lines.zh: 谁挡在前面，我就用门角顶他。
lines.en: Whoever stands ahead gets a door corner in the ribs.

lines.zh: 我用门底当扫帚，推开落叶。
lines.en: I use the door's bottom edge to sweep leaves aside.

lines.zh: 身上的铁片叮当，走一路响一路。
lines.en: The scrap metal on my body clangs with every pace.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但从不后退一步。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I never take a step back.

lines.zh: 我把门立起来，靠着它歇会儿。
lines.en: I prop the door upright and lean on it to rest.

lines.zh: 我数着门上的钉子打发时间。
lines.en: I count the nails in my door to pass the time.

lines.zh: 我伸手把护甲的破口按平。
lines.en: I press a torn gap in my armor flat again.

lines.zh: 阳光晒着我的脸，我不觉得疼。
lines.en: The sun burns my face and I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我试着挥了挥门，风呼呼响。
lines.en: I swing the door once, and the air whooshes.

lines.zh: 有只乌鸦落在门框上，我赶走它。
lines.en: A crow lands on my doorframe; I shoo it off.

lines.zh: 我低头检查鞋底还粘着什么。
lines.en: I look down to check what is stuck to my soles.

lines.zh: 门后的木纹我早已摸熟。
lines.en: I know every grain of this door by touch.

lines.zh: 我咬紧牙关，骨头咯咯作响。
lines.en: I clench my jaw and my bones grind together.

lines.zh: 我抬手扶正歪掉的门闩。
lines.en: I reach up and straighten the crooked door latch.

lines.zh: 我把门抬高，从缝里看你。
lines.en: I raise the door and watch you through the gap.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子了，站远些。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; stand farther back.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，估量你手里的家伙。
lines.en: I tilt my head, sizing up what you carry.

lines.zh: 你的斧头，我认得。别靠近。
lines.en: That axe of yours, I know it. Stay back.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的火把，往后退半步。
lines.en: I stare at your torch and shift back half a step.

lines.zh: 我看你很久，一句话也不说。
lines.en: I look at you a long while and say nothing.

lines.zh: 我抬门挡住脸，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I lift the door over my face, leaving one eye.

lines.zh: 你在数我的护甲，我也在数你。
lines.en: You count my armor plates; I count you, too.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里挤出低低的哼哼。
lines.en: A low grunt squeezes out of my throat.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的脸，别以为我忘。
lines.en: I have memorized your face; do not think I forget.

lines.zh: 门裂了一道缝，我照样站着。
lines.en: A crack splits my door and I keep standing.

lines.zh: 你砍中我肩膀，铁片掉了。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and a plate drops off.

lines.zh: 有点疼，但我不太在意疼。
lines.en: It stings, but I do not much mind stinging.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把门重新扶正。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and set the door straight again.

lines.zh: 这一剑砍得浅，我的骨头硬。
lines.en: That cut went shallow; my bones are hard.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，又踩回原地。
lines.en: I step back once, then step back into place.

lines.zh: 血早就干透了，渗不出几滴。
lines.en: My blood dried through long ago; barely a drop seeps.

lines.zh: 你打得不错，可惜我不怕。
lines.en: You hit well, but I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 我把受伤那边藏到门后。
lines.en: I hide my hurt side behind the door.

lines.zh: 疼一下，我就更想砸你。
lines.en: One burst of pain and I want to smash you more.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我的胃早不动了。
lines.en: You hold out bread; my stomach stopped working long ago.

lines.zh: 我不吃熟肉，我啃生骨头。
lines.en: I do not eat cooked meat; I chew raw bone.

lines.zh: 你手里那束花，我拿来插门缝。
lines.en: That flower in your hand would plug a crack in my door.

lines.zh: 金苹果对我没用，收起来吧。
lines.en: Golden apples do nothing for me; put it away.

lines.zh: 你晃着胡萝卜，我只看你的手。
lines.en: You wave a carrot; I only watch your hand.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想拆了你的门。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I just want to tear down your door.

lines.zh: 你把骨头丢过来，我踢回去。
lines.en: You toss me a bone; I kick it back.

lines.zh: 食物收好，我闻着像腐土。
lines.en: Keep your food; I smell of rotten earth.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我也不会有半点感激。
lines.en: Feed me and I will feel not a shred of thanks.

lines.zh: 我盯着你腰间的面包，只想砸烂它。
lines.en: I eye the bread at your belt and want to smash it.

lines.zh: 门板撞上你，你退了两步。
lines.en: My door slams into you and you stagger two steps.

lines.zh: 我肩上的铁片刮住你的袖子。
lines.en: The scrap on my shoulder snags your sleeve.

lines.zh: 让开，这扇门不认路。
lines.en: Move aside, this door does not know the way.

lines.zh: 你撞在我门角上，捂着肋骨。
lines.en: You hit my door's corner and clutch your ribs.

lines.zh: 我顶着门往前走，你被推开。
lines.en: I push forward behind the door and you get shoved aside.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，门轴惨叫一声。
lines.en: We collide and the door hinge shrieks once.

lines.zh: 我的护甲硌得你手疼吧。
lines.en: My armor must be hurting your hand.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，门会夹住你。
lines.en: Do not press so close; the door will pinch you.

lines.zh: 你退开，我才把门放回身侧。
lines.en: You step back, and only then do I lower the door.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，算打过招呼了。
lines.en: One bump from me counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 我心里没有那种念头，只有门。
lines.en: There is no such urge in me, only the door.

lines.zh: 我这样的东西，不会再有伴。
lines.en: A thing like me will not find a mate again.

lines.zh: 别对我示好，我的心早停了。
lines.en: Do not court me; my heart stopped long ago.

lines.zh: 我只会把手搭在门闩上。
lines.en: All I do is rest my hand on the latch.

lines.zh: 死人谈什么情，你走开。
lines.en: What romance is there for the dead? Walk on.

lines.zh: 我连自己叫什么都记不全了。
lines.en: I cannot even recall my own name in full.

lines.zh: 若要作伴，我只和这扇门。
lines.en: If I keep company, it is with this door.

lines.zh: 我的戒指锈在指骨上了。
lines.en: My ring has rusted onto the finger bone.

lines.zh: 你靠近，我只想举门。
lines.en: When you come near, I only want to raise the door.

lines.zh: 土里埋过的，不谈这些。
lines.en: Things buried in dirt do not talk of such things.

lines.zh: 地上有块铁片，正好补肩甲。
lines.en: A scrap of iron on the ground fits my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 我捡起门闩，塞进腰间的绳里。
lines.en: I pick up a latch bar and tuck it into my belt rope.

lines.zh: 这半扇门归我了，你别抢。
lines.en: This half-door is mine now; do not grab it.

lines.zh: 我捡起钉子，一颗颗别在袖口。
lines.en: I pick up nails and pin them into my cuff one by one.

lines.zh: 斧头我不捡，我看见就烦。
lines.en: I leave the axe; the sight of one irritates me.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，门压在背上吱呀响。
lines.en: As I bend, the door on my back creaks.

lines.zh: 一块烂木板，够我换掉门底。
lines.en: One rotten plank is enough to patch my door's base.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的锁头挂上门环。
lines.en: I hang a found padlock on my door ring.

lines.zh: 这顶破头盔，正好扣在脑袋上。
lines.en: This cracked helmet fits right over my skull.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，弯一次腰要喘半天。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly; one bend costs me a long groan.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，门先抬起来。
lines.en: I have seen you; the door comes up first.

lines.zh: 那边有个活人，我改方向。
lines.en: There is a living one over there; I change course.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声太响，藏不住的。
lines.en: Your footsteps are too loud to hide.

lines.zh: 我盯住你手里的斧，先杀你。
lines.en: I fix on the axe in your hand and come for you first.

lines.zh: 村口那个影子，我认得是村民。
lines.en: That shape at the gate, I know a villager when I see one.

lines.zh: 我把门转向你，脚下开始动。
lines.en: I turn the door toward you and my feet start moving.

lines.zh: 活物都算目标，不分好坏。
lines.en: Anything alive is a target; good or bad does not matter.

lines.zh: 你回头了，正好，我不用找。
lines.en: You looked back; good, I need not search.

lines.zh: 我嗅到你身上的铁味和汗味。
lines.en: I catch the iron and sweat on you.

lines.zh: 那个背对我的，先解决他。
lines.en: The one with his back to me, him first.

lines.zh: 我把目标记在门板上，用指甲。
lines.en: I scratch my target onto the door with a nail.

lines.zh: 你站得太久了，我决定是你。
lines.en: You have stood there too long; I choose you.

lines.zh: 我看见火光，就往火光那边走。
lines.en: I see firelight and head toward it.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来我更想追。
lines.en: Do not run; running only makes me keener.

lines.zh: 那人后退了，追上去更省事。
lines.en: He backed away; chasing is easier.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，门始终朝你。
lines.en: I close in step by step, door always facing you.

lines.zh: 你绕左，我就把门挪到左边。
lines.en: You go left; I slide the door left.

lines.zh: 我不喊，我只让门轴替你叫。
lines.en: I do not shout; I let the hinge cry for you.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我就慢慢压上去。
lines.en: You back into a corner and I press in slowly.

lines.zh: 我等你的斧先落下来。
lines.en: I wait for your axe to fall first.

lines.zh: 门挡住了你的视线，这就够了。
lines.en: The door blocks your sight; that is enough.

lines.zh: 你算你的，我算我剩下的三步。
lines.en: You do your sums; I count my last three steps.

lines.zh: 我贴着你走，像一堵会动的墙。
lines.en: I shadow you like a wall that walks.

lines.zh: 门板举起来，挡住你的斧。
lines.en: I raise my door and block your axe.

lines.zh: 我不急，死人最不缺时间。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the dead have time to spare.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我听着呢。
lines.en: You are breathing hard; I am listening.

lines.zh: 我把门抬高半寸，准备砸。
lines.en: I lift the door half an inch, ready to slam.

lines.zh: 你踩到碎石，我知道你要跑。
lines.en: You crunch the gravel; I know you will run.

lines.zh: 退路我堵住了，门横在门口。
lines.en: Your way out is blocked; my door lies across it.

lines.zh: 我把门斜过来，挡住你的剑路。
lines.en: I tilt the door to block your sword line.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就往你脚下压。
lines.en: Raise your arm and I press at your feet.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡住了门，但挡不住脚。
lines.en: Your shield stops the door, not the boot.

lines.zh: 我等你砍第二下，那时你手低。
lines.en: I wait for your second swing, when your hands drop.

lines.zh: 门板拍下去，你的剑歪了。
lines.en: The door comes down and your sword goes wide.

lines.zh: 我用门沿磕你的手腕。
lines.en: I crack the door's edge against your wrist.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在你盾上，木屑乱飞。
lines.en: This blow lands on your shield and splinters fly.

lines.zh: 我抬手，指甲先划到你脸。
lines.en: I raise my hand and my nails rake your face first.

lines.zh: 你挡上面，我就撞你膝盖。
lines.en: You guard high; I ram your knee instead.

lines.zh: 门一收一放，你的架势就散了。
lines.en: The door pulls back and thrusts, and your stance breaks.

lines.zh: 我扛着你的剑，把门推到你胸口。
lines.en: I catch your blade and drive the door into your chest.

lines.zh: 铁片割开你的袖子，血滴在门上。
lines.en: Scrap metal slices your sleeve; blood drops on the door.

lines.zh: 我不用技巧，我只用重量。
lines.en: I have no technique; I only have weight.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就跟半步。
lines.en: You give half a step; I take half a step.

lines.zh: 门框卡住你的武器，拔不出来。
lines.en: The doorframe traps your weapon; you cannot pull it free.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩住你的脚背。
lines.en: I plant my boot on top of your foot.

lines.zh: 骨头碰铁，响声传得很远。
lines.en: Bone meets iron, and the clang carries far.

lines.zh: 你砍进门板，我顺势把门一拧。
lines.en: Your blade sinks into the door; I twist it away.

lines.zh: 门沿撞上你的肋骨，闷响一声。
lines.en: The door edge hits your ribs with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀顶你，把你推离墙。
lines.en: I shoulder you away from the wall.

lines.zh: 我从土里撑起身，门还握在手里。
lines.en: I push up out of the soil, door still in hand.

lines.zh: 夜色里多了一扇会走的门。
lines.en: The night gains a door that walks.

lines.zh: 我先摸门，再摸自己的脸。
lines.en: I touch the door first, then my own face.

lines.zh: 有东西把我从坟里叫起来了。
lines.en: Something has called me up out of the grave.

lines.zh: 我站在路口，挡住所有过路人。
lines.en: I take my place at the crossing and block every passerby.

lines.zh: 这扇门不知从哪捡的，但很称手。
lines.en: I do not know where I found this door, but it suits me.

lines.zh: 我的关节咔咔响，算是醒了。
lines.en: My joints crack; that counts as waking.

lines.zh: 阳光打在我脸上，没有烧起来。
lines.en: Sunlight strikes my face and I do not burn.

lines.zh: 我低头看看身上这副破甲。
lines.en: I look down at this battered armor I wear.

lines.zh: 白天的村子也该有守门的东西。
lines.en: Even a daytime village deserves a doorkeeper.

lines.zh: 我把门在身前立正，站好。
lines.en: I set the door upright before me and stand.

lines.zh: 我记不得是谁把我从土里翻出来。
lines.en: I cannot recall who dug me out of the earth.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有脚步声，先等等。
lines.en: I hear footsteps far off; I will wait.

lines.zh: 门后的黑暗，跟我一起出来了。
lines.en: The dark behind the door came out with me.

lines.zh: 火苗爬上我的袖子，我拍不掉。
lines.en: Flame climbs my sleeve and I cannot slap it off.

lines.zh: 落地时我的膝盖磕在石头上。
lines.en: My knee cracks against stone when I land.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的护甲缝里，沉甸甸。
lines.en: Water fills the gaps in my armor, heavy and cold.

lines.zh: 冲击把门掀翻，我趴在地上。
lines.en: The blast flips my door and slams me down.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在门板上，晃个不停。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my door and keeps wobbling.

lines.zh: 那股紫色的力量钻过我的骨头。
lines.en: That violet force crawls straight through my bones.

lines.zh: 我早该饿死了，胃里空空的。
lines.en: I should have starved long ago; my gut is empty.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的门烧黑了一块。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and chars a patch of my door.

lines.zh: 脚下的黑吞掉了我的半只靴子。
lines.en: The dark below swallows half of one boot.
